toegepas.blok: Drie punte om na 'n dans te kyk
toegepas.voor: onder wie die dans gegroei het
toegepas.na: onder wie die dans ontwikkel het
toegepas.rede_vinder: A dance 'ontwikkel' rather than 'groei' in natural Afrikaans; the same change is proposed in the two later blocks and should be kept or dropped together for consistency.
toegepas.fout: 'gegroei' for a dance taking shape copies English 'grew'; Afrikaans says 'ontwikkel'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same meaning, more natural verb, and kept consistent with changes 2 and 6.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Same as block one: 'ontwikkel' is the natural verb for a dance taking shape; keep consistent with the other two.
toegepas.fout: 'onder trekarbeiders gegroei' is the same calque of 'grew' as in block one.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Natural verb for a dance's origin, meaning unchanged, consistent with 1 and 6.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'rondom' is clearer for a Grade 5 reader than bare 'om' for 'around' a place.
toegepas.fout: Bare 'om' after 'goudmyne' can make a Grade 5 reader expect 'om te' and stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'rondom' says 'around' unambiguously and the place stays the same.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'daarna' can be read as 'afterwards'; 'dit' refers clearly to the dance, as 'skoolspanne dans dit' does just before.
toegepas.fout: 'kom daarna kyk' can be read as 'come afterwards to look'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'kom dit sien' points clearly to the dance, like 'skoolspanne dans dit' before it, with the same meaning.

toegepas.blok: Gumboot-dans: hoe dit lyk en klink
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subject and verb (hulle dans / 'n kitaar speel), so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb (hulle dans / 'n kitaar speel).
toegepas.rede_keurder: Required punctuation under AWS 2017; nothing else changes.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Same as the gumboot block: 'ontwikkel' is the natural verb; keep consistent with the other two.
toegepas.fout: 'Ballet het in Europa gegroei' uses the same calque of 'grew'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'ontwikkel' is the natural verb and keeps the three blocks consistent.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'die meeste' needs a countable plural; 'ballette' (ballet works) keeps the qualifier and reads naturally.
toegepas.fout: 'die meeste ballet' copies English 'most ballet'; Afrikaans needs the countable plural with 'die meeste'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'In die meeste ballette' keeps the qualifier and the claim exactly and reads naturally.

toegepas.rede_vinder: It is the dancers, not the dance, that stamp; clearer for Grade 5 and matches 'gumboot-dansers skop ook hoog' later in the block.
toegepas.fout: The dance itself is made to stamp, which jars; it is the dancers who stamp.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same claim with the right agent, matching 'gumboot-dansers skop ook hoog' later in the block.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Same as the previous sentence: the dancers try to look light, not the dance; keeps the pair parallel.
toegepas.fout: 'Ballet probeer lig lyk' has the dance trying, which only people can do.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same meaning with the right agent, and keeps the pair parallel with change 9.

laat_vaar.voor: Langs mekaar wys die drie punte hoe verskillend die twee danse is.
laat_vaar.na: Die drie punte wys hoe verskillend die twee danse langs mekaar is.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: As written, 'langs mekaar' attaches to the three points rather than the two dances; the reorder fixes the reference without adding words.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The fronted 'Langs mekaar' reads naturally and echoes the heading; the reorder is a lateral move that now suggests the dances stand physically side by side.

laat_vaar.voor: Dit is die klem en nie die enigste
laat_vaar.na: Dit is die klem, nie die enigste
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'en nie' makes the contrast read like an addition; a comma states the contrast directly and saves a word.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Dit is die klem en nie die enigste ...' is ordinary natural Afrikaans; the comma version is only different.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The fixed expression is 'in karakter bly'; 'in sy karakter' sounds like his personality, and the change saves a word.
na_skrywer.fout: 'bly in sy karakter' breaks the fixed expression 'in karakter bly' and can read as keeping his own personality.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: A real fault, but it is inside a glossary definition, which only the writer may change for every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer
